candidates: When destructuring an array to skip one or more leading elements, use an empty slot (e.g., `const [, value] = arr`) rather than a throwaway `_` variable. Named-but-unused `_`-prefixed bindings can trigger the project's `@typescript-eslint/naming-convention` lint rule and require a suppression comment. Default values can be applied in the same pattern (e.g., `const [, value = []] = arr`), removing the need for a separate fallback assignment.
